verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gemini can generate images, refine them with local edits, and download them at 1K or 2K resolution. It also says Gemini can edit content in connected apps and help with writing. That covers iterative creation and export only for images, not for documents or presentations. Missing for 10: documented document creation and editing workspace, presentation/slide generation, export to document or presentation formats (e.g. Docs/PDF/PPTX), independent hands-on corroboration.
